conditions.t: The seed picks day, dusk, night or the weather that suits this map
Low red sun, long shadows; units see a little less far. Gunfire lights the field
Dark battlefield: units see a little less far (tanks, aircraft, commandos and recon keep thermal sight); fire and flashes light the field
The sun moves: a full day passes in 48 game minutes, starting at an hour the battle picks. Night cuts sight, and fog, sandstorms and thunderstorms (aircraft grounded) roll in
Rain: vision and accuracy a little down, mud slows ground units. Temperate maps only
Brown haze: units see a little less far and shoot a little worse. Desert and Gulf maps only
Snowfall: white haze, deep snow slows ground units. Snow maps only

rain.name: Rain
rain.tip: Mud slows ground units, visibility and accuracy drop.

fog.name: Fog
fog.tip: Heavy fog: units see barely half as far. Ambush weather.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.tip: Sandstorm: units see a little less far and shoot a little worse; aircraft fly slower.

snow.name: Snow
snow.tip: Deep snow slows ground units; vision and aircraft are a little worse.

storm.name: Thunderstorm
storm.tip: Thunderstorm: aircraft and drones are grounded and return to base; sight and accuracy drop and ground units slow a little.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.tip: Blizzard: snow slows everything, jets grounded, vision cut.

difficulty.tip: Slow to build and attack, small waves, no tricks
Fast, rich and cunning: early attacks, flanking, focus fire, pulls back damaged units
Hard's tactics, sharper: faster thinking, more flanking, focus fire, raids on supply trucks, damaged units pulled back to repair. No extra money and no extra vision
